verified_facts.text: The hotel sits on the Left Bank, between the Seine and Boulevard Saint-Germain.
verified_facts.excerpt: between the Seine and Boulevard Saint-Germain

verified_facts.text: The hotel is steps away from the literary cafes and art galleries of Saint-Germain-des-Prés.
verified_facts.excerpt: steps away from the literary cafés and art galleries that shaped the legend of the neighbourhood

verified_facts.text: The neighbourhood around the hotel is the Paris that inspired Hemingway, Sartre and Simone de Beauvoir.
verified_facts.excerpt: the Paris that inspired Hemingway, Sartre and Simone de Beauvoir

verified_facts.text: The hotel is wrapped in warm wood tones with an intimate atmosphere.
verified_facts.excerpt: Wrapped in warm wood tones and an intimate atmosphere

verified_facts.text: The rooms and suites are light-filled.
Rooms look out over Parisian rooftops, with Haussmann rooftops and monuments in sight.
verified_facts.excerpt: From your room with Parisian rooftop views

verified_facts.text: Depending on their location and orientation, certain room categories offer a view of the Eiffel Tower.
verified_facts.excerpt: Depending on their location and orientation, certain room categories offer a view of the Eiffel Tower.

verified_facts.text: The hotel's flagship family accommodation is the 2-Bedroom Panoramic Terrace Suite, designed for up to 5 guests.

verified_facts.text: Each Junior Suite has a living area with a sofa bed for two children under the age of 12.
verified_facts.excerpt: Each suite features a dedicated living area equipped with a sofa bed, carefully selected to provide a restful night

verified_facts.text: Breakfast is served overlooking the hotel's Japanese garden.
The hotel offers its guests direct access to L'Atelier de Joël Robuchon.

verified_facts.text: Bar F-Sharp hosts live jazz every Monday, Thursday and Saturday evening.

verified_facts.text: Every month the hotel's lounges host literary dinners, orchestrated by journalist and writer Olivier Barrot, bringing together an author and guests around a gastronomic dinner.
